rules.description: BOM versions have approval, activation, and date/site/quantity validity; these are separate concepts.

provenance.note: Concept only; the exact selection algorithm is the version-selection sample policy.

rules.description: Expand Phantom groupings into material components; Item lines terminate the material path.

provenance.note: No route merging, pegged supply, vendor operations, formulas, or production execution.

rules.description: Blocked inventory is not available; normalized physical sources must not be duplicated by overlapping hold records.

provenance.note: Exact status and reservation handling are documented sample policy, not an ERP transaction implementation.

rules.description: Require the exact tables and fields, strict dates and types, finite canonical decimals, EA units, 200 rows per table, bounded quantities, the shared 8 MiB input/result file limit, and consistent IDs; malformed or contradictory input rejects without a plan.

provenance.note: All limits and rejection codes are defined in HOW_TO.md; booleans are not quantities and absent data is not zero.

rules.description: Collapse identical same-primary-ID rows once with a reported exception; conflicting same-ID records reject, never last-row-wins.

provenance.note: Rows with different IDs remain distinct, including equal-valued BOM paths.

rules.description: Use the explicit inclusive as_of through horizon_end window; report out-of-scope orders and allocate in start_date, ascending priority, order_id order.

provenance.note: No wall clock, calendar engine, scheduling optimization, or overdue demand inference.

rules.description: Select exactly one approved active applicable default, or the explicitly requested approved applicable version even if inactive. Apply the order's start date/site and exact parent demand quantity at every Phantom level. Ambiguous defaults reject; invalid or missing selection leaves the order unresolved.

provenance.note: All validity boundaries are inclusive. Explicit root selection does not authorize an invalid version or choose a newest version; Phantom levels use defaults.

rules.description: Support Item and Phantom only; reject ancestor cycles, more than eight line levels, more than 5000 expanded line-path occurrences per input, and any nonzero Phantom scrap. Count Phantom prefixes and unresolved branches as well as Item leaves.

provenance.note: An empty applicable BOM is unresolved rather than zero demand. Cycle/depth/path errors reject the entire result; repeated Phantom paths are bounded even when they reach no Item leaves. Paths are not deduplicated by equal quantities.

rules.description: Multiply exact Decimal parent quantity by quantity_per along each path, apply scrap_percent only to Item leaves, sum by order/component, then ceil once to whole EA. Canonical quantity_per and scrap_percent have at most four fractional places; scrap is 0..25 percent.

provenance.note: No binary floats, per-path ceiling, or intermediate phantom rounding. Per-order/component required EA is limited to 1000000.

rules.description: Match component and site; available status, known required expiry, expiry at or after need date, and physical less external reservations determine eligible current stock. External reservations exclude these orders by definition.

provenance.note: Wrong-site, hold, blocked, expired, missing controlled expiry, and fully reserved sources are excluded. The remaining nominal source balance is not itself availability.

rules.description: Only same-site confirmed inbound with as_of < expected_on <= need date is prospective supply. Unconfirmed, overdue/same-day unreceived, late, unknown-item, and wrong-site supply is not current availability.

provenance.note: Future receipts are expectations, not physical stock or evidence of their eventual lot quality/expiry.

rules.description: Conserve one report-local balance per source across orders. Use eligible stock before inbound, earliest stock expiry with undated stock last, earliest receipt date, then case-sensitive source ID. Retain partial incomplete-kit assignments without backtracking.

provenance.note: Component and site totals reconcile; no solver, globally optimal schedule, reservation, substitution, or inventory mutation is claimed.

rules.description: Report unknown item/version references and orphan BOM lines. An order with any unresolved product, component, or Phantom selection has no partial requirement or allocation ledger; unrelated resolvable orders may still be reviewed.

provenance.note: Never create master data, infer an EA conversion, treat missing expiry as valid, or silently fall back from a requested version.

rules.description: Emit selected versions, exact paths, demand, eligibility, assigned-now/prospective quantities, source conservation, exclusions, reviewer states, and a queue; all outcomes require human review and prohibit production authorization.

provenance.note: Covered-now and covered-with-expected-receipt are calculation states, not permission to kit, release, reserve, or manufacture.

steps.title: Read the logical exports
steps.procedure: Read the bundled JSON snapshot, explicit dates, and actual row counts. Do not claim physical multi-file ingestion.

steps.title: Validate and reconcile source records
steps.procedure: Validate exact fields, types, dates, IDs, units, line types, canonical decimals, and physical/reserved quantities. Collapse identical duplicates once. Reject malformed or contradictory records before calculating a plan.

steps.title: Join demand to approved root versions
steps.procedure: Order the in-scope work orders. Join item and version exports with inclusive site/date/quantity conditions; distinguish an explicit approved alternative from an active default. Retain unresolved reasons rather than inventing a version.

steps.title: Traverse actual material paths
steps.procedure: Walk sorted BOM line IDs; join Phantom demands to valid default versions using exact parent quantities. Track ancestors, line depth, and the input-wide leaf-path count. Record selected versions and exact material paths only for completely resolvable orders.

steps.title: Sum first and round once
steps.procedure: Sum exact leaf quantities per order/component, including leaf-only scrap, then apply one whole-EA ceiling and the component quantity bound.

steps.title: Explain eligible and excluded sources
steps.procedure: Cross-reference each requirement with component-matching stock and inbound. Record the first applicable exclusion reason; do not convert a late, blocked, wrong-site, or unknown source into availability.

steps.title: Assign from conserved report-local balances
steps.procedure: Walk orders and components deterministically. Snapshot remaining eligible current and future pools, then consume stock before inbound using expiry/date/source-ID ties. Leave partial incomplete-kit assignments in the report.

steps.title: Expose evidence gaps and shortages
steps.procedure: Combine actual duplicate, scope, unknown-reference, supply-exclusion, and material-gap observations. Preserve explicit rejection reasons and never publish a partial plan for a fatal error.

steps.title: Reconcile quantities and reviewer work
steps.procedure: Reconcile required = assigned + gap and each nominal source net = assigned + remaining. Classify unresolved, shortage, expected-receipt, and current-coverage review states; assign role-based review ownership and stable queue ordering.

steps.title: Close the office review calculation
steps.procedure: Write the shared result envelope and actual trace. Mark every successful calculation review-only with no authorization, reservations, inventory changes, substitutions, or releases. Native execution remains unverified.
